sloka: तत्सैन्यं हरिवीराणां त्रासयामास राक्षसः।मृगयूथमिव क्रुद्धो हरिर्यौवनदर्पितः ।। ६.७१.४३ ।।
transliteration: tatsainyaṁ harivīrāṇāṁ trāsayāmāsa rākṣasaḥ।mṛgayūthamiva kruddho hariryauvanadarpitaḥ ।। 6.71.43 ।।

translations.english: Just as a young lion with youthful pride would strike a group of deer, the enraged Rakshasa struck the army of monkey heroes.
